action: At a v1 planter NONE with positive quoted cost, sufficient residual after other commitments, and a valid stay and move without friendly conflict, rank legal physical movements by SHA256(UTF8(f'{seat}|{t}|{uid}|{physical_cmd}')), ascending bytes. No seed, hidden state, opponent commands, names or future actions. Keep v1 except when p_stay >= .20 and p_stay >= p_move+.05. At most one veto per move, pick lexicographically first eligible triggered UID, expiry immediate. Other original v1 commands stay byte-for-byte equivalent.

mechanism_gate: For both batches require full public agent vs independently reconstructed v1 command, eligibility, movement, probabilities, and final emitted command to match on every examined step. For each of the four source terrains require strictly positive net immediate rescues and zero newly caused immediate deaths from actually changed commands. Report missed rescues and forgone purchases. If any condition fails retire this candidate without new native games, release the slot. No parameter changes.
native: If both gates pass and hardware and map clearance are signed, evaluate complete original Master3s2 with native search, original temperature/sampling and official termination. First parent, then candidate, two maps x both physical seats each. Wait for the shared between-batch slot, no overlapping native jobs. Keep every game including genuine early extinction, full cash and action evidence, independently verify exact official scores and release attribution per candidate turn. Current optional human game-source directories outside the signed registries are not attested.
decision: This is an exploratory eight-game development comparison with two independent terrains. Report every map/seat, wins/draws/losses, delta U and margin, positive/negative map effects, not a promotion. A directional follow-up signal requires both map mean margin deltas positive, positive delta U in at least 3/4 pairs, no fewer wins. No early success, promotion or claim about population win-rate; no further use of these maps for independent examination.
